helptext: Condition is true if a physical body's parts velocities are below the threshold for a given time

OnNotSet.helptext: Invert the checking logic (which means that the condition is checking for 'not moving' instead of 'moving'.

MinFramesBelow.helptext: Number of frames the velocities must be below thresholds to trigger the condition.

VelocityThreshold.helptext: Minimum average velocity per physics part to dip below to fulfil the condition.

AngularVelocityThreshold.helptext: Minimum average angular velocity per physics part to dip below to fulfil the condition.
